harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The clause «فاتقوا الله» is resumptive. «بينكم»: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with kasra. The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you are believers, then fear Allah".

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the noun relative, with no grammatical position. «زادتهم إيمانا»: a past verb, and its two objects are the hāʾ and «إيمانا». The clause «يتوكلون» is conjoined to the conditional clause «وإذا تليت عليهم ...», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «الذين يقيمون»: the relative noun is a badal (substitute) from the preceding relative noun, in the position of the nominative. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفقون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «هم»: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. «حقا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, its implied form being: "a true belief". «عند ربهم»: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «درجات». The clause «لهم درجات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «المؤمنون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «كما»: the kāf stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "the spoils are established for Allah with an establishment like the establishment of your being brought out", and «ما» is maṣdariyya. «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «أخرجك». The clause «وإن فريقًا من المؤمنين لكارهون» is a ḥāl from the kāf in «أخرجك», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: His words «بعدما تبيَّن»: «ما» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «يجادلونك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «كارهون», and the clause «كأنما يساقون» is a second ḥāl from the latent pronoun in «كارهون»; «كأنما» is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), with no governing effect. The clause «وهم ينظرون» is a ḥāl from the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), from the wāw in «يُساقون».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «وإذ يعدكم» is resumptive, and the clause «يعدكم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر. The interpreted maṣdar «أنها لكم» is a badal (substitute) from «إحدى», i.e. "its being yours". The interpreted maṣdar «أن غير ذات» is the object of «ودَّ». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يحق» is the object of «يريد».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: His words «ليحق»: the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by أن optionally concealed after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يقطع», and «الحق» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). His words «ولو كره»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); this ḥāl (circumstantial) is conjoined to an implied (muqaddar) ḥāl, the implied form being: "in every state, even in this state"; this is for exhausting all the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, and the clause is a ḥāl from the establishing understood from his words «ليحق».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر, and the clause «تستغيثون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition «من الملائكة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of ألف, and «مردفين» is a second naʿt of ألف. The interpreted maṣdar «أني ممدكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «إلا» is for restriction, and «بشرى» is the second object of «جعله». His words «ولتطمئن»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is causal, and the verb is accusative by أن optionally concealed; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, conjoined to «بشرى». It was made genitive because the condition of the agent being the same is not met: the agent of the making is Allah, while the agent of the reassurance is the hearts. The preposition «من عند الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), «إلا» is for restriction, and the clause «وما النصر إلا من عند الله» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «إذ يغشيكم»: a badal (substitute) from «إذ» in verse 9, and «أمنة» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). The preposition «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ماء». The interpreted maṣdar «ليطهركم» is genitive by the lām, attached to «يُنزل», and the interpreted maṣdar «وليربط» is conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar, i.e. "for purifying and for strengthening".

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «إذ يوحي»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) from {إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ}, and the interpreted maṣdar «أني معكم» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ. The clause «فثبِّتوا» is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar «أني معكم». The clause «سألقي» is parenthetical between the two conjoined verbs, and the clause «فاضربوا» is conjoined to «فثبتوا», in the position of the jussive [Translator's note: so in the source]. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «كل», and «كل» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The interpreted maṣdar «بأنهم شاقوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ذلك». «من» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ, and the clause «ومن يشاقق» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: (ذلكم فذوقوه) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] A demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "the punishment"; the lām is for distance, and «كم» is for address. His words «فذوقوه»: the fāʾ is for conjunction, and an imperative verb; the clause «فذوقوه» is conjoined to the clause «ذلكم العقاب». The wāw in «وأن للكافرين» is a conjunction; the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "decreed", i.e. "the punishment's being for the disbelievers is decreed". The clause of the interpreted maṣdar and its khabar is conjoined to the resumptive clause «ذلكم العقاب».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The conditional clause is the answer to the vocative, resumptive. «زحفا» is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), and «الأدبار» is a second object. The clause «لقيتم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «من»: a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). «يومئذ»: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يولِّهم»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn compensates for a clause. «دبره» is a second object. «إلا» is for restriction. «متحرفا»: excepted from the generality of states; it is originally an exception from an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "whoever turns them his back in any state at all except such-and-such a state". The preposition «لقتال» is attached to «متحرفا», and the preposition «من الله» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «غضب». The clause «مأواه جهنم» is conjoined to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). His words «وبئس المصير»: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "Hell", and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The fāʾ in «فلم» is resumptive. «إذ رميت» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رميت». The clause «ولكن الله قتلهم» is conjoined to the clause «لم تقتلوهم», the clause «وما رميت» is conjoined to the clause «لم تقتلوهم», and the clause «ولكن الله رمى» is conjoined to the clause «وما رميت». His words «وليبلي»: an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e. "and He did that in order to test". The clause «وفعل ذلك» is conjoined to the clause «ولكن الله رمى». His words «بلاء»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «ذلكم»: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "the matter"; the clause «ذلكم الأمر» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «وأن الله»: the wāw is a conjunction, then an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) and its noun; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the nominal clause, i.e. «ذلكم الأمر وأن الله موهن».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: His words «شيئا»: stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "an availing, little or much". His words «ولو كثرت»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), conjoining to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the implied form is: "in every state, even in this state"; this is for exhausting all the states. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "even if it were many, it would not avail you". The clause «ولو كثرت» is a ḥāl from «فئتكم». The interpreted maṣdar «وأن الله ...» is accusative by removal of the preposition, the lām, i.e. "He did such-and-such because Allah..."; the implied clause «فعل» is conjoined to the clause «لن تغني».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «يا أيها الذين»: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; «ها» is for drawing attention, and the relative noun is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause «وأنتم تسمعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تَوَلَّوا».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «وهم لا يسمعون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun «نا» in «سمعنا».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «عند الله»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شر». «الصم البكم» are two khabars (predicates) of «إن», and the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition «فيهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «خيرًا». The clause «ولو علم الله» is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّ شَرَّ}, and the clause «ولو أسمعهم» is conjoined to the clause «لو علم الله». The clause «وهم معرضون» is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تولَّوا», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «إذا»: purely adverbial, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استجيبوا, and the clause «دعاكم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله يحول» takes the place of the two objects of علم, and the second interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the first, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: His words «لا تصيبن»: «لا» is prohibitive, and the verb is an imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive; the nūn has no grammatical position, and the fāʿil (agent) is the pronoun "it". The relative noun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The prohibition is in form addressed to the calamity and in meaning to those addressed. The clause is governed by an omitted saying, and that saying is the adjective, i.e. "a trial about which it is said: «لا تصيبن»", meaning: "do not engage in causes through which a calamity will strike you that does not single out the wrongdoers among you". The clause «لا تصيبن» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative; the implied form is: "a trial about which such-and-such is said". The preposition «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw, i.e. "they did wrong, being from among you". «خاصة» is a ḥāl from the object, which is the relative noun, i.e. "it will not strike the wrongdoers exclusively; rather it will include them and include others".

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause «أنتم قليل» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «مستضعفون» is a second khabar (predicate), and the preposition after it is attached to (mutaʿalliq) it. The clause «تخافون» is a third khabar. The clause «لعلكم تشكرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يتخطفكم» is a mafʿūl bihi.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وأنتم تعلمون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «تخونوا».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أنما أموالكم» takes the place of the two objects of علم, and the second interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to the first. The clause «عنده أجر» is the khabar (predicate) of «أن».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The conditional clause is the answer to the vocative, resumptive, and the clause «والله ذو الفضل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وإذ يمكر» is resumptive; «إذ» is the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر. The clause «يمكرون» is resumptive, and the clause «والله خير الماكرين» is conjoined to the clause «يمكر الله».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «لو نشاء لقلنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إن هذا إلا أساطير»; «إن» is negating, «إلا» is for restriction, and «أساطير» is the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: His words «وإذ قالوا»: conjoined to «إذ» in verse 30. «اللهم»: the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; the mīm compensates for (يا). «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, «الحق» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, and the preposition «من عندك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The lām in «ليعذبهم» is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the verb is accusative by a concealed أن; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of kāna, the implied form being: "intending punishment". The clause «وأنت فيهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يعذبهم», and the clause «وهم يستغفرون» is a ḥāl from the hāʾ in «معذبهم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: (وما لهم ألا يعذبهم الله) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is the khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (في). The clause «وهم يصدون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يعذبهم», and the clause «وما كانوا أولياءه» is conjoined to the clause «وهم يصدون». The clause «إن أولياؤه إلا المتقون» is resumptive; «إن» is negating and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «عند البيت»: an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «صلاتهم». The clause «فذوقوا» is resumptive, and «ما» in his words «بما كنتم» is maṣdariyya; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to «فذوقوا».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليصدوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفقون», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the verb. The clause «فسينفقونها» is resumptive. The preposition «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «حسرة». The preposition «إلى جهنم» is attached to the verb «يحشرون», and the clause of the relative noun is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The interpreted maṣdar «ليميز» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يُحْشَرُونَ}. «بعضه» is a badal (substitute) from «الخبيث». The preposition «على بعض» is attached to the second object of «يجعل». «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الخبيث», and the preposition «في جهنم» is attached to the second object of يجعل.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause «إن ينتهوا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative, and «ما» is a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «تكون»: a complete (tāmm) past verb [Translator's note: so in the source; «تكون» is an imperfect verb], and «فتنة» is its fāʿil (agent). «انتهوا» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on a ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif dropped because of the meeting of two vowelless letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil. The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله مولاكم» takes the place of the two objects of علم. The clause «نعم المولى» is resumptive, and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. "Allah".

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: «ما»: a relative noun, the noun of «أن»; the preposition «من شيء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما». His words «فأن لله»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), by likening the relative noun to the condition; the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "obligatory". The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. His words «يوم التقى»: a badal (substitute) from the first «يوم».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكروا, and the clause «أنتم بالعدوة» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the position of the genitive. His words «والركب أسفل منكم»: the wāw is a conjunction, «الركب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «أسفل» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «منكم» is attached to «أسفل». His words «ليقضي»: an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن [Translator's note: the source reads «مضمرة بالفعل», "concealed with the verb"; presumably "after the lām"], and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to the verb «تلاقيتم», implied. The clause «ولكن تلاقيتم» is conjoined to the conditional clause. The preposition «ليهلك» is a badal (substitute) from «ليقضي», and the relative noun «مَنْ» is the fāʿil (agent). The preposition «عن بينة» is attached to «يحيا».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «إذ»: an adverbial noun, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر. «يريكهم» is an imperfect verb taking two objects, the kāf and the hāʾ; the preposition «في منامك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and «قليلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ. The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «يريكهم», in the position of the genitive. The lām in «لتنازعتم» is for added linking, and the preposition «في الأمر» is attached to «تنازعتم». The clause «ولكن الله سلَّم» is conjoined to the clause «ولو أراكهم», in the position of the genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to {إِذْ يُرِيكَهُمُ}. The wāw in «يريكموهم» is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), with no grammatical position. «إذ التقيتم»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. The interpreted maṣdar «ليقضي» is genitive, attached to «يقلِّلكم», and the clause «كان» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمرا», in the position of the accusative. The clause «ترجع» is resumptive, and the preposition «إلى الله» is attached to «ترجع».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The conditional clause is the answer to the vocative, resumptive; the clause «لقيتم» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «كثيرا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «لعلكم تفلحون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: His words «فتفشلوا»: the fāʾ is causal, and the verb is an imperfect, accusative by أن necessarily concealed after the fāʾ of causation; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no disputing among you, and so failure". The clause «تفشلوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «بطرًا»: a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «ما» in his words «بما يعملون» is maṣdariyya, and the interpreted maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «والله بما يعملون محيط» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «إذ»: the object of an implied (muqaddar) اذكر, and the clause is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «اليوم» likewise; the preposition «من الناس» is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «لكم». The clause «وإني جار لكم» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «فلما تراءت الفئتان» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إذ زين», and the clause «إني أرى» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: «إذ يقول»: a badal (substitute) from «إذ» in the previous verse. «هؤلاء» is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «دينهم» is a fāʿil (agent) placed later. «مَن» is a conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يتوكل» is its khabar (predicate); the conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «إذ»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ترى». «الذين» is a relative noun, an object placed first, and «الملائكة» is a fāʿil (agent) placed later. The clause «يضربون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الملائكة». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e. "you would have seen a tremendous matter". «ذوقوا» is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted saying, in the position of the accusative, and the implied clause of saying «يقولون» is conjoined to the clause «يضربون», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The preposition «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar «وأن الله» is conjoined to «ما», the genitive relative noun. «ظلام» is an intensive form, and the bāʾ in the khabar of laysa is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The preposition «كدأب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied form is: "the habit of these is like the habit". The clause «دأبهم كدأب» is resumptive, and the clause «كفروا» explains the habit.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The interpreted maṣdar «بأن الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). «يك» is an imperfect abrogating verb (nāsikh), jussive (majzūm) with a sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn dropped for lightness; «مغيرًا» is the khabar of kāna, and «نعمة» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle «مُغَيِّرًا». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يغيِّروا» is genitive by «حتى», attached to «مغيرًا», and the preposition «بأنفسهم» is attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The interpreted maṣdar «وأن الله سميع» is conjoined to the preceding interpreted maṣdar «أن الله لم يكُ مُغيرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The preposition «كدأب»: the preposition is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject); the implied form is «دأبهم كدأب». The clause «كذَّبوا» explains the habit, with no grammatical position. The clause «وكل كانوا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «دأبهم كدأب».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The adverb «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شَرّ», and «الذين» is the khabar (predicate) of inna. The clause «فهم لا يؤمنون» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) «كفروا», with no grammatical position, and the clause «لا يؤمنون» is the khabar of «هم».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: «الذين عاهدت»: a badal (substitute) from the preceding relative noun. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «وهم لا يتقون» is conjoined to the clause «ينقضون».

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «فإمَّا تثقفنهم»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إما» is composed of the conditional «إنْ» and the redundant «ما»; the verb is an imperfect, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn of emphasis, in the position of the jussive; the clause is conjoined to {إِنَّ شَرَّ} .... The preposition «في الحرب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تثقفنهم», and «خلفهم» is an adverb attached to the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause). The clause «لعلهم يذَّكَّرون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: The preposition «من قوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «خيانة», and the preposition «على سواء» is attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) and the object together. The clause «إن الله لا يحب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: His words «ولا يحسبن»: the wāw is resumptive, «لا» is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is attached to the nūn, in the position of the jussive; its first object is omitted, its implied form being: "themselves", and the clause «سبقوا» is a second object. The clause «إنهم لا يعجزون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: «ما»: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition «من قوة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The clause «ترهبون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «أعدوا». His words «وآخرين»: a noun conjoined to «عدوكم», and the preposition «من دونهم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of آخرين. The clause «لا تعلمونهم» is a second naʿt of آخرين, and the clause «الله يعلمهم» is a third naʿt. His words «وما تنفقوا من شيء»: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is conditional, mafʿūl bihi, and the verb is jussive (majzūm); the preposition «من شيء» is attached to a naʿt of «ما», and the preposition «في سبيل» is attached to a naʿt of «شيء». The clause «وأنتم لا تظلمون» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «إليكم», in the position of the accusative.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The clause «إنه هو السميع» is resumptive; «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه», and «السميع العليم» are two khabars (predicates) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يخدعوك» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «هو الذي» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and «جميعًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الأرض». The clause «ولكنَّ الله ألف» is conjoined to the clause «ما ألَّفْت», and the clause «إنه عزيز» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ومن اتبعك»: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is an implied (muqaddar) (كذلك), and the preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf in «اتبعك».

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The conditional clause is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative. «عشرون» is the noun of يكن, and the tamyīz (specification) of the number has been omitted. «مائتين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative. The preposition «من الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ألفًا», and the clause «لا يفقهون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «الآن»: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خفف», indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. The interpreted maṣdar takes the place of the two objects of علم. The clause «فإن يكن» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. The preposition «بإذن الله» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يغلبوا».

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن يكون» is the noun of kāna, and the preposition «لنبي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «تريدون» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: «لولا»: a particle of non-occurrence because of occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «كتاب» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: "existing". The preposition «من الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب», and the clause «سبق» is a second naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The fāʾ in «فكلوا» conjoins to something implied (muqaddar), i.e. "I have made the spoils lawful for you, so eat". The implied clause «أبحت» is resumptive. The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كلوا». «حلالا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it is originally an adjective of an omitted qualified noun, i.e. "eat lawful food".

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «النبي»: ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The preposition «في أيديكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) ṣila (relative clause), and the preposition «من الأسرى» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun. The conditional clause is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl), in the position of the accusative. The second «خيرًا» is a second object. The preposition «ممَّا» is attached to «خيرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «وإن يريدوا» is conjoined to the preceding answer to the vocative.

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The clause «أولئك بعضهم أولياء بعض» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن». His words «ما لكم من ولايتهم من شيء»: «ما» is negating and inoperative; the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar, and the preposition «من ولايتهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء»; «شيء» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ما لكم شيء» is the khabar of «الذين». The interpreted maṣdar «حتى يهاجروا» is attached to an omitted khabar of «شيء». The clause «فعليكم النصر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The preposition «إلا على قوم» is attached to a ḥāl from the omitted excepted, i.e. "except help being against a people". The clause «بينكم وبينهم ميثاق» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوم», in the position of the genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: «بعضهم»: a second mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «أولياء», and the clause «بعضهم أولياء بعض» is the khabar of «الذين». The clause «إن لا تفعلوه تكن» is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «تكن» is a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb.

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «أولئك هم المؤمنون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين»; «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). «حقًا» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "believers with a true belief". The clause «لهم مغفرة» is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: «بعدُ» is indeclinable (mabnī) because it is cut off from annexation. His words «فأولئك»: the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and it was attached to the clause of the khabar (predicate) by likening the relative noun to the condition; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «بعضهم أولى ببعض» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أولو». The preposition «ببعض» is attached to «أولى».
